channel.title: Ken Taylor - Blog
channel.description: Thoughts, tutorials, and insights on tech, music production, and entrepreneurship from a Guyanese developer.

item.title: From Internet Cafes to VPS: How I Became a Programmer in Guyana
item.description: A journey from bash scripts on borrowed computers to building Luge Tech and self-hosting everything. The story of learning to code in Guyana's internet cafe era.

item.title: Developers Using AI: Beyond the 'Vibe Coder' Slur
item.description: The 'vibe coder' label is becoming a slur. Here's the real divide between developers who use AI responsibly and those who don't—and why the distinction matters more than the tool itself.

item.title: Why I Created Lyricut: Solving a Real Radio Problem
item.description: One wrong word can cost you $250,000 in fines. Here's how I built Lyricut.com and the Lyricut Editor to solve radio censorship problems and why people around the world is using it.

item.title: Where Code Meets Music: My Journey as a Developer-Music Producer
item.description: For over a decade, I've balanced software development with music production. Here's how these two worlds inform and inspire each other.
